pro_course_detail.title: American English Pronunciation/ Accent Reduction- INTENSIVE
pro_course_detail.description:
I specialize in American English Pronunciation/ Accent Reduction for intermediate and advanced-level grammar students. My classes are very structured and start with a PDF and audio file that I will send you before class begins. Each class will be based on the aforementioned PDF and audio files. My classes are very focused so be prepared to jump into the fundamentals of American English Pronunciation. In my class, you will learn proven techniques to reduce your accent. We will start with the vowels- monophthongs and diphthongs, and the I.P.A- International Phonetic Alphabet. I will break it down into easy and understandable language. We will study mouth, tongue, and lip positioning, as well as other techniques in order to achieve those often difficult vowel sounds. We will then move on to reductions, syllable stress, intonation, word linking, pitch, connected speech, fricatives, consonant clusters, the schwa, the stop consonants- stopT&D/B&P/G&K, the flapT, the R, the L, the TH and more... 
My style of teaching is very focused and structured so that you get the most out of every class. You will learn very specific techniques to achieve serious results. This class is for students who are serious about reducing their accent and committed to learning pronunciation the correct way. My students get results quickly because we don't waste any time taking a deep dive into proven techniques that work.
This class can also be modified and changed to adapt to the needs of the student.

teacher_info.teaching_style:

2) We'll work together on the most glaring issues in your accent. If you can't make the sound, I'll help you to produce it. 

3) Once the sound is produceable, we'll use repetition of it within sentences, to get it into your muscle memory. Repetition is crucial for muscle memory retention. We'll also shadow (mimic) native speakers in series, movies and podcasts. I'll be giving you continual feedback as we progress.

pro_course_detail.title: American Pronunciation & Accent Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn how to speak with the North American accent.
Pronunciation is not only about individual sounds, it also involves intonation and Word Groups: Groups of words that flow together. This is a key aspect to North American pronunciation. We are a mumbling people. Our language is casual, and it flows. As a non-native, you're used to separating almost every word, using strong consonant sounds. In music theory that's called 'staccato'. But it's very un-American to speak that way. I will teach you how to modify sounds in order to create the American flow in your own speech.

You'll learn all about American speech patterns, intonation, tongue positioning, voice placement, breath, shadowing; stop consonants, vowel reductions, word linking, function/content words, the schwa, which sounds Americans erase--and when, the Flap T, pitch and syllable stress, voiced vs. unvoiced, and more.  

You can continue on with me as your accent coach, or take the self-practice I teach you, and improve on your own. But with the matrials and knowledge I provide, the choice will be yours.

This is an intensive course for students at intermediate to advanced proficiency levels, focusing on writing and editing. This is not a translation class, your draft must be in English for this class. 

In this course, we will edit your document drafts together. For this reason, it is required that you send me the drafts along with a detailed explanation of the purpose of the document the moment you book your class, with a minimum of 24-hours' notice. Otherwise, unless you made a prior arrangement with me, your lesson request will be declined. You must send the documents in PDF format, via Skype message. This type of preparation is necessary so that we don't spend precious time during class gathering that information.

How long it takes to completely edit a document depends on many factors including its length, its (actual and intended) content, how quickly you understand and implement the corrections, and how often you take this class. For instance, most simple business letters that contain two paragraphs (each one containing three or fewer sentences) can take approximately one to two classes to edit completely. This can vary, based on the factors I listed above. 

We will review the corrections during class to help you understand and retain the reasons for the edits. As with all of my classes, we will use total immersion (this means we speak only English), and you will be expected to review between sessions to maintain steady progress. 

Remember, the goal is to build on previous lessons. See you in class!
